aarti.pad1: Victory to you, Mother Candraghaṇṭā, abode of happiness; fulfil my works. Like the moon you are the giver of coolness, and you dwell in the moon's bright rays. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: You are the mistress of the mind, and you delight the heart; Candraghaṇṭā, you are the giver of boons. You bring forth beautiful feelings and save in every danger. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: Whoever meditates on you every Wednesday, offers his prayer with faith, makes an image in the shape of the moon and lights a lamp of ghee before it, ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: and, bowing his head, tells what is in his heart — fulfil his hope, O giver to the world. Kāñcīpura is your seat; in Karnataka you are honoured. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: I repeat your name, great Queen; protect this devotee, Bhavānī. ॥5॥
